data.name: Twins of the Pasture
data.detailed_description:
This is a story about twin sisters who live in the pasture.
Their parents ran away leaving a huge debt.
Two sisters have to pay back money in 120 days…


Kurore

The older sister of Aluka. She has black hair just like her father and her behaviour is invective and moody.She can’t communicate well outside her family.

Aluka

The younger sister of the twins, her hair is blonde same as her mother.
A kind girl and that is the reason why she is always being "bullied" by her sister.
She is popular in town opposite of her sister and takes gifts from people.


Charnes

The daughter of the mayor, the bully of the town. According to her personality, it's easy to see she don’t have any friends. And at the most, she doesn't like twins.

Features:

  • Twin sisters are both playable characters.
  • Unique Story for each character.
  • Multiple ending
  • Main story and side missions to play.
  • Dynamic time system.
  • Character voice include

reviews.review:
Twins of the Pasture is a story-driven adventure with light simulation elements developed and published by Dieselmine. The game centers on twin sisters Kurore and Aluka, whose lives are thrown into turmoil after their parents disappear and leave them burdened with an enormous debt. Forced to become independent, the sisters have only 120 days to earn enough money to save their home and future. This simple premise creates a constant sense of urgency, making every decision feel important as players attempt to balance daily responsibilities with the progression of the narrative.

One of the game's biggest strengths is the way it presents two distinct protagonists rather than treating the twins as interchangeable characters. Kurore is blunt, stubborn, and often struggles to communicate with others, making her storyline feel more confrontational and emotionally tense. Aluka, meanwhile, approaches life with kindness and optimism, allowing her to build relationships more naturally despite facing the same difficult circumstances. Experiencing the story from both perspectives gives the narrative additional depth, revealing different interactions, dialogue, and emotional moments that encourage multiple playthroughs. The sisters' contrasting personalities create believable conflicts while also highlighting the bond that keeps them moving forward despite overwhelming odds.

The game's progression is driven by a calendar system that steadily counts down toward the repayment deadline. Rather than allowing unlimited freedom, the time limit encourages careful planning, as each activity consumes valuable days. Players divide their attention between earning money, interacting with townspeople, and advancing personal storylines, making resource and time management important without becoming overly complicated. This system successfully adds tension throughout the adventure, preventing the experience from feeling static even during quieter moments.

Outside of the main objective, Twins of the Pasture includes numerous side events that expand the personalities of supporting characters and enrich the setting. The town feels populated by individuals with their own motivations, friendships, and rivalries. Characters such as the mayor's daughter introduce additional conflict that shapes both sisters' journeys in different ways. Optional events and branching choices gradually influence the direction of the story, while multiple endings reward players who experiment with different decisions across separate playthroughs. These features significantly improve replay value by ensuring that a single run does not reveal every scene or conclusion.

Visually, the game embraces a colorful anime presentation that complements its emotional tone. Character illustrations are expressive, helping conversations feel more engaging even when much of the gameplay revolves around dialogue. The rural setting is presented with pleasant environments that reinforce the peaceful atmosphere of the countryside, creating an interesting contrast with the financial pressure hanging over the protagonists. Voice performances further enhance important scenes by giving the cast greater personality and emotional weight, making dramatic moments more memorable.

Although the narrative remains the primary attraction, the gameplay mechanics are intentionally straightforward. Players looking for a complex farming simulator or deep economic management system may find the mechanics somewhat limited, as they mainly serve to support the unfolding story. Daily routines can occasionally become repetitive, especially during longer sessions, and some dialogue sequences move at a slower pace than necessary. Additionally, the game contains mature content intended for adult audiences, making it less suitable for players expecting a purely wholesome slice-of-life adventure.

Despite these limitations, Twins of the Pasture succeeds by combining an engaging dual-perspective narrative with meaningful player choice and a constant sense of urgency. The emotional relationship between the sisters remains the heart of the experience, while the countdown mechanic gives the story momentum that keeps players invested from beginning to end. Those who enjoy visual novels with branching paths, character-focused storytelling, and light management mechanics will likely appreciate what the game offers, especially when exploring both protagonists' routes to uncover every ending and hidden detail.

Rating: 7/10
